Q: Create a new column in pandas conditionally based on two other columns that may have overlapping values A:

You can use vq clustering function from scipy.cluster (prepared data taken from @Fred Bill answer).

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.cluster.vq import vq

df = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        [1305, 893, 279],
        [1389, 901, 291],
        [1753, 973, 683],
        [1864, 984, 694],
        [2080, 902, 313],
        [2115, 898, 299],
        [2377, 908, 272],
        [2452, 911, 286],
        [2779, 886, 277],
        [2872, 891, 293],
    ],
    columns=["Data", "X", "Y"],
)

points_of_interest = np.array(
    [
        [1200, 700],
        [1000, 300],
        [900, 300],
        [700, 500],
    ]
)
df["closest"] = vq(df.iloc[:,1:], points_of_interest)[0]

df now has:

   Data    X    Y  closest
0  1305  893  279        2
1  1389  901  291        2
2  1753  973  683        0
3  1864  984  694        0
4  2080  902  313        2
5  2115  898  299        2
6  2377  908  272        2
7  2452  911  286        2
8  2779  886  277        2
9  2872  891  293        2

closestcolumn now contains the indices of the points_of_interest array, which values are closest to the corresponding point in initial df.

Q: How can I restart multiple apps at once A:

I wonder how can I restart multiple applications in ArgoCD in one command?

I just checked (4 years later: Q3 2026), but the current argocd app actions run command still does not support multiple app names or -l.
And its --all option means "all matching resources" of that Application, not all matching Applications.

So... the for i in $(argocd app list -l yourgroup=your.label --output name); do remains not just a "working around a transient 2022 bug". It actually is compensating for a capability that app actions run does not provide even today (2026): it still does not provide the multi-Application selection supported by app sync.

There was also a separate Argo CD bug reported in the comments. Ganesh Hegde reported:

Unable to create audit event: namespaces "mynamespace" not found

when running argocd app actions run ... restart, with Argo CD 2.4.14, 2.4.17 and 2.5.2.

That matches argoproj/argo-cd issue #11233, opened the same day, which reports the same failure and the same tested versions. That issue is still open as of Q3 2026.
But it is separate from the OP's question, though: it concerns a failure while running the restart action on an Application, not "how to select several Applications for that action" (which is what the OP is asking).

Q: ripgrep to find files which contain multiple words, possibly on different lines? A:

You can chain two searches using piping. The null delimiter safely handles filenames with spaces or special characters.

rg -l -0 "bar" | xargs -0 rg "foo"

Here are the relevant GitHub discussions I could find with answers by the maintainer.

  • Proper way to search for term1 AND term2
  • Only files who match all the words
  • Something similar to a sub search

Q: Check if constructor is ill-formed A:

For types which are not SFINAE friendly, you cannot verify that definition would produce hard error when declaration tell the method is valid.

You might do specialization for some of those unfriendly-SFINAE types and do the check yourself :-/

Q: Can't find Abort method in Thread A:

Thread.Abort has been removed in .NET Core.

  • Move Thread.Abort under FEATURE_LEGACYSURFACE https://github.com/dotnet/coreclr/pull/2342
  • Never call Thread.Abort https://github.com/aspnet/KestrelHttpServer/pull/726
  • for tests purpose the custom Abort Ext method is used

Q: Maven svn: E215004: Authentication failed and interactive prompting is disabled; see the --force-interactive option A:

Subversion really changes from 1.6.x to 1.8.x. This problem may be due to that (especially using Windows + Active Directory).

If invoking maven from eclipse it then tries to access the SVN not using Subclipse. Assume that you even use an external Maven installation. This external installation does not know your Eclipse / Subclipse and thus calls SVN available on your platform (depending on Windows path variable). This SVN for does not know of your Eclipse and hence has to get the credentials from somewhere else (for example %USER%\AppData\Roaming\Subversion\auth). Unfortunately at this point something seems to have been broken with the maven-release-plugin since SVN protocol version 1.6.

Currently no best solution is known and it is unclear what exactly causes the maven-release-plugin to fail. The best work around maybe to provide the credentials in the Eclipse Run configuration (JRE tab, then argument Dusername=... -Dpassword=...).

I would recommend not to store the credentials somewhere where they might be accidentally exploited to others.

Q: Need to populate master list from many different sheets in excel A:

Elaborating on @Skip Intro's solution:

  1. Ensure all three sheets have the same labels (say Item and Qty), preferably in Row1.
  2. Alt+D then P, select Multiple consolidation ranges and PivotTable, Next, Next.
  3. Select your range from Sheet1 (say A:B), Add, repeat for Sheet2 and Sheet3, Finish.
  4. Change Count of Value to Sum of Value, if required and might as well select PivotTable, PivotTable Options, Totals & Filters, untick (if necessary) Show grand totals for rows.
  5. If you don't want (blank) to show either filter it out or restrict the data ranges (at the start) to less than whole columns.
